Name: Marnie is a Good Aunt (Redux)
Author: deleted127110843
Description:
This mod is an update of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5033]Marnie is a Good Aunt[/url], which I uploaded to Nexus from another account (Under my given name, Erin) in December of 2019. This redux version was also initially posted to Nexus, but taken down due to an unexpected hiatus I took.

This version adds three dialogue edits, as well as a couple schedule changes. Marnie speaks better of Shane, and no longer leaves Jas home alone while she goes to the saloon. If you just want the event changes, there is a config that can be edited. If you want to use the version that is compatible with [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/487802-immersive-characters-shane]Immersive Characters - Shane[/url], the original mod is still available to download.

Check out this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9813]Brazilian Portuguese[/url] translation of the mod!

Manifest.Name: Marnie is a Good Aunt (Redux)
Manifest.Description: Small event changes, dialogue changes, and schedule changes to make Marnie more appreciative and caring towards Shane and Jas.
Manifest.Author: Pebble
